name: Triceps Dip
steps: Grip the parallel bars with palms inward and press into straight-arm support with your torso upright.
Pack your shoulders down away from your ears and brace your core firmly.
Bend your elbows straight behind you close to your ribs to lower your body smoothly until your upper arms reach roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive firmly down through your palms to extend your elbows back to full lockout.
tips: Stay tall and upright with tucked elbows to focus tension on your triceps rather than leaning forward onto your chest.
Stop descending before your shoulders roll forward or feel pinched at the bottom.
